company.name: Meridian Field Solutions Ltd
company.description: Field-sales and technical-services company running a mixed company-car fleet for a UK-wide sales force, split between allocated perk cars for senior account managers and a bookable pool of cars and a crew van shared across the Birmingham head office and regional hubs in Manchester, Leeds and Bristol. The fleet team manages driver-vehicle reservations, business/private mileage capture for HMRC, benefit-in-kind (BiK) taxable-value tracking, grey-fleet and licence checks, and routine DVSA MOT and servicing. Cars are predominantly low-emission petrol hybrids and BEVs to keep BiK and Advisory Fuel Rate costs down. No operator (O) licence is required for the car fleet; the single 3.5t demo/crew van is run on a maintained car-derived basis and does not trigger O-licensing.

metadata.generatedNote: Realistic example dataset reflecting a typical operating week (2026-06-22 to 2026-06-28) for a small UK company-car / sales-force pool fleet. Generated for the FleetFlow / Armada v2 schema. Reflects the pool reservation calendar, allocated perk cars, business/private mileage split for HMRC mileage and fuel-benefit purposes, benefit-in-kind taxable-value tracking (P11D value, CO2/BiK percentage, appropriate amount), driving-licence and grey-fleet validity checks (DVLA View Driving Licence), and pool utilisation reporting. Verified against DVSA MOT and roadworthiness rules, DVLA licensing, HMRC company-car and fuel-benefit rules (BiK appropriate percentages, Advisory Fuel Rates / Advisory Electricity Rate), and Companies House registration. The car fleet does not require a GB operator (O) licence. All free text is in English; all monetary values are in GBP.

notes.author: Fleet Manager
notes.body: Suspended Hannah from pool driving. Her photocard licence expires on 31 July and she is carrying 6 points (MS90 from Nov 2024). DVLA check still returns valid today but the imminent expiry plus the points means I want a renewal in hand and a short risk review before she takes another pool car. Reassign the Manchester booking POOL-2026-5103 or push it to next week.

Confirmed the EGR valve is at fault and the front discs and pads are below limit. Parts on order, ETA tomorrow lunchtime. Car is VOR and off the bookable pool until repaired and road-tested.

notes.author: Payroll / Fleet

notes.author: Payroll / Fleet
notes.body: Reviewed Catriona's private-fuel benefit on the Glasgow Corolla. She has done 4,120 private miles year-to-date and wants to keep the benefit. At 27% BiK her car-fuel benefit charge works out around the 27,800 fuel-benefit figure times the BiK percentage. Confirmed it still makes sense for her given the private mileage; flagged we will recheck at year end.

notes.author: Fleet Coordinator
notes.body: Gave Sophie the high-mileage diesel Octavia for the five-day Sheffield/Newcastle trip rather than a pool EV - the long motorway legs and limited overnight charging up north made diesel the sensible choice. Full tank out, fuel card issued, refuel-before-return reminded. All business miles; no private use expected.

notes.author: Fleet Coordinator
notes.body: Booked the Manchester pool Niro EV as a cover car for Daniel while his perk ID.7 goes in for the software recall on Friday. Treated as business-use cover, not a benefit change - the perk allocation stays on his ID.7. Charge card travels with the pool car; back in the pool the same evening.

notes.author: Marcus Dube
notes.body: Crew-van demo at Aire Valley Logistics confirmed for Thursday. I hold the 3.5t van familiarisation briefing so I'm cleared to take the Transit Custom. Demo kit to be loaded at Birmingham first thing; it's an on-site product demo in their yard, transport office hosting. Will log it as a business pool booking.

notes.author: Fleet Manager
notes.body: Manufacturer flagged a software recall on Daniel's ID.7 (infotainment and charging-map update). Booked it in with the Manchester dealer for Friday and arranged a pool Niro EV as cover so he keeps moving. No safety risk to drive in the meantime, but better done promptly.

notes.author: Olivia Harrington
notes.body: Logged today's perk-car trip as 60 business miles, no private use - mileage app set to business at the start and confirmed at the end. The business/private switch on the telematics matched my app entry. Charged from 92% to 71% over the round trip; plenty of range, no charging stop needed.

notes.author: Aaron Greenwood
notes.body: Aire Valley are a live prospect for the field kit. I'll take a pool hybrid up on Friday for the pre-demo meeting, then Marcus brings the crew van with the full demo kit the same week. Keen to see the kit working in a van rather than just a slide deck - good signal.

notes.author: Catriona Buchanan
notes.body: Logged a 20-mile private detour at lunch on the Glasgow trip and classified it private. As my car keeps the fuel benefit I'm not claiming any Advisory Fuel Rate for it - the private fuel is covered by the benefit charge. Business portion of the day was 40 miles to and from Clydeside.

notes.author: Marcus Dube
notes.body: Two-day NHS framework review at Severnside in the Bristol pool hybrid. Used the pre-booked visitor bay 2 and my NHS site ID at reception. Next-period volumes confirmed. 64 business miles so far, nothing private - I park the pool car back at the Bristol hub overnight.
